Qix npm maintainer account compromise

Target: qix-npm-account
Date: 2025-09-08
Actor: Third Party (group)
Target Kind: library
Language: JavaScript
Cause: social_engineering
Motive: financial_gain
Transitive: false
Impact: credential_theft, financial_exploitation, self_propagation
User Impact: 50000000
Phase: distribution
Campaigns: Qix npm Phishing Package Compromise

Synopsis

Attackers phished prolific npm maintainer Josh Junon with the fake npmjs.help domain, intercepted credentials and 2FA tokens, and used the captured npm access to publish malicious releases across 18 packages he maintained. The poisoned utility packages carried a crypto-clipper and credential-harvesting worm, turning tiny dependencies with enormous install reach into a broad wallet-theft and propagation surface.
